title: Audiform theme
description: A theme file (.audtheme): a look for the whole app, as a style sheet with its pictures inside. See docs/themes.md.

version.description: Version of this file format. Audiform refuses a number higher than it knows.

id.description: Unique id, lowercase letters, digits and single dashes. Saved in the settings, and the style sheet is written against `:root[data-theme="<id>"]`. `dark` is taken by the built-in look.

name.description: The name shown in the theme list.

base.description: Which built-in colors the theme starts from. `light` also makes form controls and scroll bars start light.

description.description: One or two sentences about the look, shown under the list.

secret.description: A secret theme is not listed until its id is in the `unlockedThemes` setting.

css.description: The style sheet text. Pictures are written `url(asset:<name>)`. `@import`, `image-set()` and any other address in `url()` are refused. Up to 512 KB.

assets.description: Every picture or font the style sheet and the pointers use, by name, as a base64 `data:` address. Up to 200 assets of 8 MB each.

pointers.description: Pictures for the mouse pointer, by kind. A kind that is left out keeps the standard pointer.

hot.description: The hot spot, in pixels from the picture's top left corner: x and y.

canvasLook.description: Flags for views that draw themselves, so no code has to know a theme by its id. Unknown flags are ignored.

pixel.description: Views that can draw blocky (the Phase Wheel) do.

markCursor.description: Anything whose own style asks for the hand or the plain arrow is marked, so the style sheet can give it the theme's arrow.
